topic: Paying off mortgage early vs investing the difference (Thatcher vs Elise)

scenes.narration: Rushing to kill a cheap mortgage can quietly cost you a fortune in lost growth. I am Doctor Dollar. Today's patient checkup starts here.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar in an exam room beside a house and a growth chart, comic burst banner reads MORTGAGE CHECKUP, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Thatcher and Elise both hold a three percent home mortgage.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man thatcher and woman elise each beside a house stamped THREE PERCENT MORTGAGE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Each has five hundred extra dollars to use every month.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, doctor dollar holding a chart showing FIVE HUNDRED EXTRA MONTHLY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Thatcher throws every single extra dollar at his mortgage balance.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man thatcher stuffing cash into a house labeled PAY DOWN, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He chases a guaranteed three percent return on that loan.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a small meter labeled THREE PERCENT RETURN, man thatcher beside it, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Elise invests her extra five hundred in an index fund.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman elise sliding cash into a fund labeled INDEX FUND, a rising arrow, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Her investments average about eight percent over the long run.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a tall meter labeled EIGHT PERCENT AVERAGE, smiling woman elise beside it, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Thatcher pays his whole house off years ahead of schedule.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man thatcher holding a deed stamped PAID OFF EARLY, a debt free house, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Elise still owes her cheap loan but her portfolio soars.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman elise beside a tall growing portfolio, a small CHEAP LOAN tag on her house, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: After twenty years Elise's portfolio dwarfs all his interest saved.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, side by side piles, elise's towering labeled MORE WEALTH, a calendar reads TWENTY YEARS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Elise could pay the house off anytime and still win.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, smiling woman elise holding both a debt free house and a fat portfolio, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: When your mortgage rate is low, invest the difference instead. See you next visit. Stay financially healthy!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar in an exam room holding a clipboard reading INVEST THE DIFFERENCE, comic burst banner reads STAY HEALTHY, kids comic book illustration
